A deployed antenna may lean backward, but must read as UPRIGHT rather than lying horizontally. Calm dignified transport leader; original head, no exact copy of Optimus, no crown jewelry or fantasy horns. Crisp mechanical anime linework, restrained cel shading, ivory/navy/silver/orange/cyan palette identical to target, warm white plain background. No robot body, no vehicle, no decorative border, no watermark.
